verdict.rationale: Persona's own API docs list "database lookups" as an identity verification method next to government IDs and liveness, and the Transactions API supports backend-only flows with no Persona UI, which suits document-free checks. The evidence is a single thin mention, though, with no detail on which authoritative sources are queried. Missing for 10: explicit SSN verification, national registry checks, credit-header data sources, coverage by country, match/result semantics, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can verify identity against authoritative databases without documents — SSN, national registries, or credit-header data — for lower-friction flows where a doc scan is overkill

citations.quote: Perform identity verification using government-issued IDs, liveness checks, and database lookups.
Transactions API | backend-only verification APIs, no Persona UI | Fully custom UI or backend-only verification flows
